standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes qc from the pointwise check.

core_obligations: Part (1): scheme replacement (composition-smooth), local pullback keeps qc, the surjective-flat-lfp lifting lemma provides the etale covering with lifts, x_i^*F = u_i^*f^*F qc, local-final-object concludes x^*F qc, characterize-bis makes F an fppf sheaf and characterize concludes (proof lines 3454-3480).

Part (2): the same argument written out for flat lfp morphisms, using composition-flat and composition-finite-presentation, pullback-lqc, and the fppf lifting lemma, ending with the characterization lemma (proof lines 3483-3509).
proof_roadmap: Reduce the covering family to a single surjective morphism from a scheme.
Check qc on lifting coverings and conclude by the characterization lemmas.
difficulty_reason: Both parts are fully written out: replace the covering stacks by schemes via smooth coverings, take the disjoint union f to get a smooth (resp. flat lfp) surjection, lift an arbitrary object x along an etale (resp. fppf) covering so that x_i^*F = u_i^*f^*F is quasi-coherent, conclude x^*F is quasi-coherent by the local-final-object lemma, and finish with the characterization lemmas of quasi-coherent modules on stacks.
